definitions.explanation: A refundable deposit paid when renting an apartment in Japan, typically 1-2 months' rent. Used to cover repairs for damages beyond normal wear and tear.

examples.japanese: {敷金|しききん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧2⟦{ヶ月|かげつ}→ヶ月：00956_kagetsu⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The security deposit is two months' rent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敷金|しききん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返|かえ}って→返る：noentry⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Part of the security deposit was returned when I moved out.

examples.japanese: {敷金|しききん}⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧⟦なし→なし：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property with no deposit or key money.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to spread, lay) + ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ (money)

JAPANESE RENTAL SYSTEM:
・{敷金|しききん} (security deposit) - refundable
・⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧ (key money) - non-refundable
・Both are typically paid upfront when signing a lease

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{敷金|しききん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (pay the security deposit)
・{敷金|しききん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (security deposit is returned)
・{敷金|しききん}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧ (zero deposit)

NOTE: In recent years, more '0⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧' (zero-zero properties) with no {敷金|しききん} or ⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧ have become available.
